main_text.l: יַלְדוּת f. Juventa. יַלְדָּה f. Partus.
יָלַךְ Ivit, Abivit. Hiphil הוֹלִיךְ Ire fecit, Adduxit, Deduxit.
יָלֵל m. יְלָלָה f. Ejulatus. אֲלֵי Hei, Va.
יָמִין f. Dexter, a, um: Dextera manus, Dexterum latus.
הֵימִין Hiphil Dexteravit; Dexteram petiit, Dextra usus fuit.
ינח Hiphil הִנִּיחַ Posuit, Deposuit, Reliquit, Sivit, Dimisit. Hophal הֻנַּח Poni, Collocari: Relinqui.
נַחַת f. Depositum: Quies, Vide & נָחַת.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some letters in the scan are blurred and partly doubtful; entries transcribed as best legible. Heavy staining across the page.
